people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
translations.bsb: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
translations.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
translations.asv: Ye are severed from Christ, ye would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.
